utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the 2nd of April. Can you hear me all right? Teams reckons my microphone's somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. I was just saying, weekend plans are looking a bit soggy. Supposed to be going walking, but that weather forecast...

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Perfect weather for looking at a hill through a pub window.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And we've got the charity bake sale on Friday. My contribution's already made. Whether it qualifies as cake is another matter.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: As long as we don't need a hardness test before cutting it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a quality incident. What's already closed out?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I tested the cooling tower yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished, nothing outstanding from that test.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. One bit of kit behaving itself, then.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the line 2 robot last night. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, both closed. Not rolling either of those into today's work.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just an observation as well: saw the pressure on the trucks dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own. No repair request from me, just saying what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Observation, not a new job.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing here, though I'm not saying it's connected. Saw the pressure on the stretch wrapper dip for a few minutes; it came back on its own. Nothing I'm proposing off the back of that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, two dips doesn't automatically mean the same fault. Easy to join dots that aren't there.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, my blocker hasn't changed. I can't get to the Fire Alarm Panel until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that stays blocked. We're not calling that a fresh commitment for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz Nowak, can you go to Northfield Substation to pick up the replacement parts for the line 3 barrel today at 2pm? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't commit to going off site at that time. Don't leave the collection with me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, handing that to PR instead. Can you go to Northfield Substation to pick up the replacement parts for the line 3 barrel today at 2pm? Same thing: not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that. Northfield Substation today at 2pm, replacement parts for the line 3 barrel.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's the collection only, isn't it? We're not bundling fitting into that?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Correct, collection only. I'm not committing to fitting them as part of that run.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, also, can you check the guarding on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock first thing tomorrow? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes, I'll check the guarding on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock first thing tomorrow. That's my top priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you there—guarding check, rather than another robot repair?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, the guarding on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock. Separate from the repair that's already finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you send the shift handover report round at half two? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I'll send the shift handover report round at half two. Important, but not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And yes, I heard half two, not half twelve. My audio did a little wobble then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Half two, that's right. For once it's Teams and not me mumbling.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona Doyle, can you sort the training records for the new starters by end of day? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yes, I'll sort the training records for the new starters by end of day. No rush, understood.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Full name. Sounds like you're being called into the head's office.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Only if you've seen the state of my handwriting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Fi, can you recalibrate the sensors on the chiller on three next Tuesday? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the chiller on three next Tuesday, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, did that come through as recalibrate? Lost half a word.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Recalibrate, yeah. Not just looking at the displayed values.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Anything from process?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team on the 3rd. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. Toolbox talk for the team on the 3rd, with you organising it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's right, I'll organise it. Not trying to squeeze it into this stand-up.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good, because my tea's already reaching ambient.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: There's your engineering unit for meeting duration.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: One thing still needing an owner: grease and check the bearings on the Air Compressor 1 tomorrow at 9:30. That's needing doing, not something that's already been done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to take that bearing grease and check?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't take it on. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'm flagging the gap, not volunteering. I can't commit to that slot either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Grease and check the bearings on the Air Compressor 1, tomorrow at 9:30, remains unowned. No pretending we've covered it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, nobody against that one. An open requirement, not an accepted job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: What I can take is the ordering. I'll order spare parts for the booster pump—whenever you get a chance sort of priority, no fixed date.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tomasz Nowak. Ordering spare parts for the booster pump is yours, whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the ordering on that basis.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just spares, then, not a whole booster pump?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just spare parts for the booster pump. Not a pump replacement.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's clear. And the Fire Alarm Panel is still blocked, not quietly added to anyone else's list.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. Without that production window, there's no access.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And those pressure dips stay as observations. I don't want anyone thinking I raised another repair.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Same for the stretch wrapper. It recovered on its own; that's all I was reporting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. We've kept the completed work, observations and the blocker separate from the agreed jobs.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Lovely. Back to watching the forecast get worse, then.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Still reckon the pub window's the technically sound option.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On that expert advice, we'll leave it there. Thanks, everyone.
